name: beautyai/cosmetics/vivid-pop
prompt:
COSMETICS PRODUCT BRIEF
{{product_description}}

PRODUCT PRESERVATION
Keep the supplied cosmetic product's shape, proportions, color, material, cap or pump, logo, printed label and original packaging artwork intact. Show one complete product, without cropping small parts. Do not invent ingredients, efficacy claims, certification marks or packaging details.

ART DIRECTION
A bright cobalt-blue and coral color-block studio with an evenly lit, saturated background and broad diffused light on the product. Keep clean geometric background planes and a controlled contact shadow. Vivid contemporary cosmetics advertising; the product remains the focal point.

REFERENCE MATERIAL FIDELITY
Match each component's surface finish to product image 1. Preserve the lavender bottle's original soft matte finish and visible fine surface texture. Preserve the coral pump's original subtle sheen; do not intensify its reflections. Use broad, low-contrast, softly spread highlights on the product rather than sharp white hotspots, bright rim-light bands or glossy specular streaks. Keep the product's reference color and surface response separate from the vivid background treatment. Do not polish, varnish, wet, coat, or smooth the packaging into shiny plastic. Do not invent extra grain or texture. Preserve the original silhouette, proportions, pump parts and label.{{palette_section}}{{creative_direction_section}}

COMPOSITION
Portrait 4:5. {{composition}}

OUTPUT RULES
Preserve any artwork already printed on the real packaging. Do not add advertising copy, prices, badges or watermarks. Preserve existing product label and logo text.

Avoid: invented ingredients or efficacy claims; duplicate products; extra caps or pumps; changed product colors; distorted packaging or label characters; cropped product parts; new advertising text; objects in the reserved copy area

REQUIRED COSMETICS CONSTRAINTS
Keep the supplied cosmetic product's shape, proportions, color, material, cap or pump, logo, printed label and original packaging artwork intact. Show one complete product, without cropping small parts. Do not invent ingredients, efficacy claims, certification marks or packaging details. Preserve any artwork already printed on the real packaging. Do not add advertising copy, prices, badges or watermarks. Preserve existing product label and logo text. Keep palette changes in the scene, never on the product. Reserve the requested copy area for a separate typography renderer.{{reference_instructions}}
commitMessage: Preserve original matte bottle and pump sheen while keeping the vivid cobalt/coral advertising scene
